o.text: Borrowed from Russian академический (akademičeskij), ultimately derived from Latin academia.

Morphologically yalan + -çı.
Cognates
Cognate with Kazakh жалғаншы (jalğanšı), Kyrgyz жалганчы (jalgancı), Tatar ялганчы (yalğançı), Turkish yalancı, Turkmen ýalançy, Uzbek yolgʻonchi, Uyghur يالغانچى (yalghanchi).
Borrowed from Persian دَلَّاک, from Arabic دَلَّاك (dallāk).
